title: Check in
signIn: Sign in to check in at this facility. You will come back here afterwards.
loadError: The check-in could not be loaded.
qrOff: This QR no longer works here. Ask the staff, or check in another way.
scanQr: Scan the QR on the door of the facility to check in.
notHere: This facility does not take check-ins from your phone. Use the reader at the door, or ask the staff.
booking: You have a booking from {{start}} to {{end}}.
bookingIn: Your booking from {{start}} to {{end}} was checked in at {{time}}.
noBooking: You have no booking for this turn.
noBookingFlash: You have no booking for this turn. If it is free, you can book it here on the spot.
codeHelp: It is on the sheet at the door or the desk: six digits.
locationNote: We will ask for your location: you have to be within {{metres}} m of the facility. It is checked and never stored.
inaccurateHelp: Turn on precise location, or step outside for a moment, and try again.

location.denied: We need your location to check you in. Allow it for this site in your browser and try again.
location.timeout: Your location took too long. Try again.
location.unavailable: Your location could not be found. Turn on location on your phone and try again.
location.unsupported: This browser cannot share your location. Use another browser, or the reader at the door.

result.booked: Booked and checked in. Come in!
result.no_booking: You have no booking for this turn
result.too_early: It is still early: you can check in from 15 minutes before your turn.
result.method_off: This facility does not take check-ins this way.
result.invalid_qr: This QR no longer works. Ask the staff: they may have printed a new one.
result.wrong_code: That is not this facility’s code. Check the sheet and try again.
result.no_facility_location: The facility is not on the map yet, so your location cannot be checked. Ask the staff.
result.location_required: We need your location to check you in.
result.location_inaccurate: Your location is not precise enough.
result.too_far: You are too far from the facility. Check in at the door.
result.refused: The check-in did not go through.

scan.aim: Point it at the QR printed on the door.
scan.notOurs: That QR is not a facility’s entrance. Point it at the one on the door.
